entries.Translated: 欢迎来到 XIVCombo 扩展 v

entries.Original: This is the first time you're using the new version of XIVCombo Expanded.
entries.Translated: 这是您第一次使用新版本的 XIVCombo Expanded。

entries.Original:
With the introduction of new combos and features, an ever-growing list of jobs,
this plugin ended up having to be reworked for better UI & clarity.
entries.Translated:
随着新组合和功能的引入，工作列表不断增长，
这个插件最终不得不重新设计以获得更好的用户界面和清晰度。

entries.Original: First of all, it is recommended to open up the main interface and check it out.
entries.Translated: 首先建议打开主界面查看一下。

entries.Original: Combo categories: Classic, Expanded, Accessibility and Secrets.
entries.Translated: 组合类别：经典、扩展、辅助功能和秘密。

entries.Original: Classic mirrors the Vanilla XIVCombo features.
entries.Translated: 经典反映了 Vanilla XIVCombo 的功能。

entries.Original: Expanded follows the set of rules that XIVCombo Expanded used to follow.
entries.Translated: Expanded 遵循 XIVCombo Expanded 过去遵循的一组规则。

entries.Original:
Accessibility adds previously hidden features which aim at increasing
accessibility for every player and remove more buttons.
entries.Translated:
可访问性添加了以前隐藏的功能，旨在增加
每个玩家的可访问性并删除更多按钮。

entries.Original:
Secrets adds the rest of the previously hidden features which were
either unintuitive or forcing specific rotations for small benefits.
entries.Translated:
Secrets 添加了之前隐藏的其余功能
要么不直观，要么为了小利益而强制进行特定的轮换。

entries.Original: Note: Each combo category requires the previous one to be enabled.
entries.Translated: 注意：每个组合类别都需要启用前一个组合类别。

entries.Original: You can check them out below, actually. How neat!
entries.Translated: 实际上，您可以在下面查看它们。多整齐啊！

entries.Original:
By default, icons are small for low-resolution users.
2k & 4k enjoyers have options for bigger icons.
entries.Translated:
默认情况下，图标对于低分辨率用户来说很小。
2k 和 4k 爱好者可以选择更大的图标。

entries.Original:
Icons may cause a loss of FPS when the Combos tab is open.
That shouldn't happen when it matters, right?
entries.Translated:
当“组合”选项卡打开时，图标可能会导致 FPS 损失。
重要的时候不应该发生这种事，对吧？

entries.Original:
Please set up your ideal configuration.
Do not worry, you will be able to change those later.
entries.Translated:
请设置您理想的配置。
不用担心，您稍后可以更改这些内容。

entries.Original: Automatically switch to your current job's tab upon opening the UI.
entries.Translated: 打开 UI 时自动切换到当前作业的选项卡。

entries.Original: Increase the size of icons for combos and features.
entries.Translated: 增加组合和功能图标的大小。

entries.Original: Increase the size of icons for the jobs on the side bar.
entries.Translated: 增加侧栏上作业图标的大小。

entries.Original: Hide icons for combos and features.
entries.Translated: 隐藏组合和功能的图标。

entries.Original: Those combos are additional features absent in original XIVCombo.
entries.Translated: 这些组合是原始 XIVCombo 中缺少的附加功能。

entries.Original: They usually aim at further reducing button bloating.
entries.Translated: 他们通常旨在进一步减少按钮肿胀。

entries.Original: They are also designed to bring QoL improvements to some jobs.
entries.Translated: 它们还旨在提高某些工作的生活质量。

entries.Original: They are meant to be used by anyone, whatever their reasons may be.
entries.Translated: 它们适合任何人使用，无论其原因是什么。

entries.Original: Enable the expanded features for XIVCombo.
entries.Translated: 启用 XIVCombo 的扩展功能。

entries.Original: Those combos are non-optimal routes which simplify a rotation overall.
entries.Translated: 这些组合是非最佳路线，整体上简化了轮换。

entries.Original: They are intuitive, and aim at considerably reducing button bloating.
entries.Translated: 它们非常直观，旨在显着减少按钮的臃肿程度。

entries.Original: They are meant to be used to give accessibility options to everyone.
entries.Translated: 它们旨在为每个人提供可访问性选项。

entries.Original: They will often lower your ability to perform well in high-end content.
entries.Translated: 它们通常会降低您在高端内容中表现良好的能力。

entries.Original: Those combos are optimization routes which give little benefits.
entries.Translated: 这些组合是优化路线，带来的好处很少。

entries.Original: They often lead to an unintuitive behavior or specific rotation routes.
entries.Translated: 它们通常会导致不直观的行为或特定的轮换路线。

entries.Original: They generally require a heavy knowledge of your job.
entries.Translated: 他们通常需要您对工作有深入的了解。

entries.Original: They are niche options, and probably pointless for most players.
entries.Translated: 它们是小众选择，对大多数玩家来说可能毫无意义。

entries.Original:
One last thing. If you used to use XIVCombo Expanded before,
you should check whether your previous settings correctly imported or not.
entries.Translated:
最后一件事。如果您以前使用过 XIVCombo Expanded，
您应该检查之前的设置是否正确导入。

entries.Original: Open the XIV Combo Expanded main interface.
Secret combos are now locked away.
Completely disables the plugin's functionalities along with every combo when unchecked.
entries.Translated: 未选中时，完全禁用插件的功能以及每个组合。
启用热栏图标重新着色。

entries.Original:
Combos that can show the same action as another one offer a color picker in the Combos tab.
The picked color tints their hotbar icon so they can be told apart; its transparency sets the tint intensity.
entries.Translated:
可以显示与另一个组合相同的操作的组合在“组合”选项卡中提供了颜色选择器。
所选择的颜色会为它们的快捷栏图标着色，以便可以区分它们；它的透明度决定了色调强度。

entries.Original:
Vibrant — fully recolors the icon toward the picked color, with a bright ambient glow. Strongest effect.
Shade — shades the icon with the color, darkening everything that doesn't match it. Subtle, keeps details.
Glow — keeps the artwork's own shading and shifts its lighting toward the color. Middle ground.
entries.Translated:
充满活力 - 将图标完全重新着色为所选颜色，并具有明亮的环境光。效果最强。
阴影 — 使用颜色对图标进行阴影处理，使所有不匹配的部分变暗。微妙，保留细节。
发光 - 保持艺术品自​​身的阴影并将其照明转向颜色。中间地带。

entries.Original: Hide children of disabled combos and features.
entries.Translated: 隐藏禁用组合和功能的子项。

entries.Original: Re-open the first time pop-up window

Enable secret forbidden knowledge.
This option requires the accessibility combos to be enabled.
entries.Translated:
启用秘密禁止知识。
此选项需要启用辅助功能组合。
打开 GitHub 存储库 URL
复制 Dalamud 存储库 URL

entries.Original: goat and the whole Dalamud team
entries.Translated: 山羊和整个 Dalamud 团队
daemitus 用于创建 XIVCombo Expanded

entries.Original: kaedys for considerably contributing to the repository
entries.Translated: kaedys 对存储库做出了巨大贡献

entries.Original: vitharr137 for some research work and collaboration
entries.Translated: vitharr137 进行一些研究工作和合作

entries.Original: Additional thanks to all those contributors
entries.Translated: 额外感谢所有这些贡献者

entries.Original: And many others who contributed through issues, bug reporting or feature requests!
entries.Translated: 还有许多其他人通过问题、错误报告或功能请求做出了贡献！

entries.Original:
This combo can show the same action as another combo.
Pick a color to recolor its hotbar icon and tell them apart.
The color's transparency sets the intensity; fully transparent disables it.
Right-click to reset to the default value.
entries.Translated:
该组合可以显示与另一个组合相同的动作。
选择一种颜色来重新为其热栏图标着色并区分它们。
颜色的透明度决定了强度；完全透明禁用它。
右键单击可重置为默认值。

entries.Original: Overrides the global coloring method for this combo only.
entries.Translated: 仅覆盖此组合的全局着色方法。
